question: On which sides should Mahākāla and Yamunā be worshipped?
premises: Mahākāla is associated with the right side.
Yamunā is associated with the left side.
inference: Therefore one should worship Mahākāla on the right and Yamunā on the left.
plain_english: One should worship Mahākāla on the right side and Yamunā on the left side.
